docs.title: CLI Usage
docs.text:
# Segment a brain MRI
brainchop input.nii.gz -o output.nii.gz

# List available models
brainchop --list

# Use a specific model
brainchop input.nii.gz -m subcortical -o output.nii.gz

# Skull stripping
brainchop input.nii.gz --skull-strip -o brain.nii.gz

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
from brainchop import load, segment, save, list_models

# Load and segment
vol = load("input.nii.gz")
result = segment(vol, "subcortical")
save(result, "output.nii.gz")

# List models
for name, desc in list_models().items():
    print(f"{name}: {desc}")

See API Reference for details.

docs.title: Batch Processing
docs.text:
from brainchop import load, segment, save

# Process multiple files
volumes = [load(f"scan_{i}.nii.gz") for i in range(4)]
results = segment(volumes, "subcortical", shard_size=2)

for i, result in enumerate(results):
    save(result, f"output_{i}.nii.gz")

docs.title: Custom Model
docs.text:
from brainchop import load, segment, save

vol = load("input.nii.gz")
result = segment(vol, "/path/to/custom/model")
save(result, "output.nii.gz")

Custom model directory must contain:

  • model.json - MeshNet configuration
  • model.pth or model.bin - Weights
